fontLicensePolicy: Existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular WOFF2 reused unchanged at weight400 in both variants. Original source and OFL notice retained.
mode: Previously generated photographic artwork and paper/device presentation reused unchanged. Native SVG typography and geometry composed separately. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Declared color-only changes isolate value contrast: four text lightness changes, one empty-checkbox stroke lightness change and a two-fill masthead treatment. Hue/saturation inputs stay fixed within each role; all geometry, typography and photographic sources remain identical.

comparisonPolicy: Only four cinema text fills, one empty-checkbox stroke and two masthead fills change. Nominal HSL hue/saturation inputs remain fixed within each role; lightness changes. Words, font settings, positions, dimensions, image bytes/crops and presentation stay identical. Checkbox remains empty; report values sum to238.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared value-contrast intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Exact DOM normalization permits only declared fill/stroke attributes. All other artifact nodes and embedded image/font bytes remain identical. Wide/stacked browser checks cover text bounds, loaded fonts, horizontal overflow, image/inline SVG equality and pixels outside declared intervention regions.

limitations: Specified digital color-pair calculations, not measured reading speed or attention. Tonal-field emphasis is editorial interpretation. HSL lightness is not perceptual lightness. Static checkbox is not an implemented accessible form. Non-text criterion applies to visual information required to identify controls/states, not every decorative boundary. No physical print proof or full accessibility conformance is claimed.
